method: Each day is built ONLY from closures and hours already verified on the Restaurants and Activities pages. A venue is placed on a day only if the calendar maths works (e.g. 9/11 Museum is shut Tuesdays; Jean-Georges is shut Sunday and Monday; the High Line shuts at 20:00 in winter). Nothing here is a booking — every slot still needs a reservation.
base_hotel_name: Eurostars Wall Street (cheapest verified queen + 3-minute walk to Crown Shy)

items.note: Room is the non-refundable Partner Offer at $848/7n pre-tax — see Booking Strategy.
Memorial only, free. The Museum is closed on Tuesdays only, so Monday works for either; it requires an advance ticket.

items.what: Crown Shy (1★) — a 3-minute walk from the hotel
items.note: Closest Michelin star to any shortlisted hotel. Reservation required.

days.why: Monday is the thinnest restaurant night in the city (Jean-Georges and many others are closed), so it is the best arrival day: a walkable star plus the free Memorial.

items.what: Le Bernardin (3★) — 26 min by transit from the hotel

days.why: Tuesday is the day the 9/11 Museum is normally shut — so the day leans on MoMA (open daily) and a Midtown 3-star.

items.what: The Met Fifth Avenue (39 min from the hotel)
items.note: $30 pp; public gallery hours are unverified (flag A-01) — confirm before going.
The Met sits on the park's east edge.

days.why: Two verified 3-stars inside the first three days, and the Met on a weekday when it is quieter than a weekend.

items.note: The only one of the verified 3-stars with a published weekday lunch window.

items.what: Top of the Rock timed entry (from $42 pp)
items.note: Open 08:00–24:00 daily; book a sunset slot early.

items.what: Eleven Madison Park (3★) — 29 min from the hotel

days.why: This is the last day of the user's PREFERRED window (15–18 Feb), so it is deliberately the strongest food day: a 3-star lunch and a 3-star dinner.

items.note: Free; the 1 December–31 March window applies to this trip.
Two pastrami sandwiches ≈ $62. Hours unverified (flag A-06).

days.why: A no-transit-friction Friday: the High Line is a short hop and only Katz's needs a bus.

items.what: American Museum of Natural History (34 min)
items.note: Open daily 10:00–17:30; closed only Thanksgiving and Christmas.

items.what: Aska (2★), Williamsburg — 32 min by NYC Ferry from Pier 11
items.note: $4.50 ferry leg; a scenic way to reach Brooklyn.

days.why: Saturday is the busiest museum day, so go early; the Brooklyn dinner uses the ferry that the transit research proved is the fastest link.

items.what: Statue of Liberty & Ellis Island (ferry from Battery Park)
items.note: Park open daily 09:00–16:30; last statue entry 15:30. No closure on this date.
Open daily 16:30–21:00 — one of the few 3-stars that trades on a Sunday.

days.why: Sunday eliminates Jean-Georges and several others; Per Se's seven-day schedule is what makes a Sunday finale possible.

items.note: Booking.com free-cancellation deadline for the refundable rate was 2027-02-13.

days.why: No Monday restaurant is booked — Monday is the weakest night and departure-day risk is highest.

rule_checks: Each of the five verified 3-stars (Eleven Madison Park, Jungsik, Le Bernardin, Per Se, Sushi Sho) appears exactly once.
No venue is scheduled on a day it is verified closed: Jean-Georges (Sun/Mon) is not used at all; Jungsik is not on a Monday; Sushi Sho is not on a Monday; the 9/11 Museum is not on a Tuesday.
Every leg in the itinerary is ≤39 minutes — inside the user's 1-hour rule.
Days 1–4 sit inside the preferred 15–18 February window; days 5–8 extend the trip to the 7-night booking.
flags: I-01: Michelin detail pages for Crown Shy and Aska were not yet harvested, so those two rows show a source link but 'unverified' status.
I-02: The Met's public hours are unverified (flag A-01), so Day 3's morning block is provisional.
I-03: Katz's opening hours are unverified (flag A-06) — a deli that closes early would break Day 5's midday slot.
I-04: Every dinner assumes a confirmed reservation; Michelin 3-star tables in NYC typically open 30–60 days ahead and sell out the same day.
